EXEC SSP0015_GET_SHIPMENT_CONFIRM_DETAIL @p_division_id='40', @p_from_site='HQ06-A', @p_item_id='MCBB45821-A1', @p_from_yyyymmdd='PSI_NAME', @p_to_yyyymmdd='PSI_NAME', @p_plan_start_yyyymmdd='20261009', @p_language='KO', @p_user_id='jaeuk.shin', @p_myModelChk='N', @p_requestor='', @p_partLeaderChk='N', @p_teamLeaderChk='N', @p_search_yn='N', @p_nonChk='Y', @p_real_flag='Y', @debug_mode='T', @p_delegateeChk='N'
EXCEPTION            :   Invalid column name 'PSI_NAME'.
Invalid column name 'PSI_NAME'.
 SELECT  AA.*  FROM      																										
  ( SELECT  a.division_id         																										
 		 , a.erp_so_no                                                                                                          
 		 , a.shipment_status                                                                                                    
 		 , a.project_code                                                                                                       
 		 , [dbo].[FN_GET_PROJECT_NAME]((case when a.division_id = 'EE' then a.origin_from_division_id else a.division_id end) ,a.project_code) project_name                                               
 		 , a.fcst_type                                                                                                          
 		 , a.item_id                                                                                                            
 		 , dbo.fn_get_item_nickname((case when a.division_id = 'EE' then a.origin_from_division_id else a.division_id end), a.item_id ) AS nick_name                                                    
 		 , CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),   CONVERT(DATETIME, a.yyyymmdd,112), 23) AS shipment_date                                       
 		 , a.before_qty AS before_qty                                                                                        
 		 , convert(int, a.qty) AS shipment_confirm_qty
